summary: Frontend-only anonymous-visitor test of the revised career area on the PREVIEW URL. Desktop at 1920px: 35/35 checks passed. Mobile at 390px: all 7 pages have no horizontal overflow and the hamburger menu works. API sanity check (2 curls): /api/careers/status returns site_public=true, applications_enabled=false, is_staff=false; /api/careers/jobs as an anonymous visitor returns items=[]. Nothing was changed in the DB, no admin login, no settings changed.

issues: Berufserfahrene card has a 3-line claim, so its icon and title sit higher than on the other two cards. Purely cosmetic (could use a fixed claim height or line-clamp).
'Nicht die passende Stelle dabei?' reads a bit oddly while 0 jobs are public (and the apply page shows the disabled notice). Optional copy tweak.

action_items: No blocking issues. Optional: line up the career-path card content heights; optionally adjust the bottom CTA copy while no jobs are public.

Informal-address grep (du/dein/dich/dir/euch) over src/pages/careers and src/components/careers found no matches.
